title: Extract direct tilemap descriptors
changes: Extend the tilemap descriptor resource with seven authenticated direct descriptors linked to the previously extracted tilemap streams, preserving guest-interpreted parameters and indexing.
validation: Source e199-descriptor-source-uottnw22 authenticates 56 bytes and the seven existing target dependencies. Wine e199-descriptors-wine-9ofg9nm8 preserves 122 other resources, rejects missing dependencies and coherent edits, checks altered mirrored/mixed reads and compares seven original interpreter/native field readers with equal complete state and guest clock.
Wine e199-descriptors-cli-wine-0bqdvd05 creates, reuses and verifies 124 matching files.
limitations: Ordinary use of the seven descriptors, other rows and consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements were performed.
